title: Social Content Pack
subtitle: 35 ready-to-post captions for cafés & coffee shops
statusNote: Stage 3 v7 — category photo pairing (7 portrait hints per pack); locked 02, 06, 21, 23, 25, 28, 29, 33.
coverStatement: 35 captions for cafés & coffee shops. Ready to copy and post.

intro.hookDescription: This pack has 35 captions for the moments that actually come up: a slow Tuesday, a new drink on the menu, the morning before anyone walks in, a question for the feed, a regular who always orders the same thing. Most are ready to copy and post.
intro.howToUse: Pick the category that matches your week — that's the scenario. Each section includes a photo idea; grab a shot that matches, then paste the caption. Most lines are ready to post. Fill [brackets] only where shown.
intro.fillInNote: Common fill-ins: [your town], [your neighborhood], [the drink or item], [day]. If a template works as-is, post it.
intro.identityKitNote: If you have an Identity Kit, swap in a line from your Voice and Content Playbook anywhere it fits. The pack works without it.

categories.title: If you're new here
categories.description: For when a new follower lands on your profile. Neighborhood energy, what kind of place this is, a reason to stop in.
categories.photoPairing: Your counter, sidewalk sign, or morning light on the storefront.

templates.text: Come work, stay awhile, have fun with us. Open late in [your neighborhood]!
New here? Start with [the drink or item]. Trust us on this one.
What a beautiful day in [your neighborhood]! Good vibes, flat whites, see you soon.
Meet me at the coffee counter. Pull up a chair.
Come along for a day of great coffee in [your town]. We're in [your neighborhood].

categories.title: Open this week
categories.description: For a slow day, early morning, or room on the counter.
categories.photoPairing: The counter ready for the morning, the front door open, or empty tables waiting.

templates.text: Ready for the week! First stop: coffee.
Doors open. Coffee's on. Slow morning if you want one.
What a beautiful [day]! A little reminder of our hours today. Have a lovely day.
Coffee, tea and more until midnight daily.
Open late tonight. Come work, stay awhile, relax, chill, get cozy. Hot and iced drinks served til midnight.

categories.title: What goes into it
categories.description: For prep, the espresso station, sourcing, or process. Name the drink or ritual, not a mission statement.
categories.photoPairing: The pour, the espresso station, or beans on their way out the door.

templates.text: [the drink or item] with our housemade syrup. Tastes like the corner piece of banana bread right from the oven.
Meet our [the drink or item]. Silky, bold, indulgent. Layers worth lingering over.
Our freshly roasted beans...heading your way!
Same beans. Same pull. Every single morning.
[the drink or item] is back on the menu. Limited run this week.

categories.title: A regular moment
categories.description: For a familiar order, a first-timer, or a small interaction. Lead with the moment, not the backstory.
categories.photoPairing: A regular at their usual seat, someone new at the counter, or a quiet moment at a table.

templates.text: The usual? Already on the counter.
Your daily ritual starts here. Try [the drink or item]. Sip with us.
Same order as always. We had it ready before you sat down.
When they ask how I like my coffee…
Oat milk this time. Same seat by the window.

categories.title: The regulars
categories.description: For shop vibe, team, or personality posts. The regulars, the crew, the mood.
categories.photoPairing: Patio regulars, the morning rush, or the corner table that's always taken.

templates.text: AI is taking jobs? I think we're safe.
Come for the caffeine, stay for the aesthetic.
When they ask how we like our coffee… black, always.
Your home away from home in [your neighborhood]. Same faces, same orders.
Golden hour hits different with a [the drink or item].

categories.title: A win this week
categories.description: For a new menu item, seasonal special, or week that felt right.
categories.photoPairing: A fresh batch from the oven, the new menu item on the counter, or the seasonal special you're proud of.

templates.text: [the drink or item] just hit the menu. don't miss out
New on the board this week. Come try it before it's gone.
Link in bio to order ahead — or walk in and mention this post for 10% off.
Sun's out, patio's open, [the drink or item] is back.
Great week behind us. Thanks for stopping in. See you soon.

categories.title: Start a conversation
categories.description: For when you want replies, not just likes. Poll energy or a casual question, no fresh hero shot required.
categories.photoPairing: The menu board, two drinks side by side, or a quick chalkboard poll.

templates.text: Hot or iced? Pick a side.
What's your go-to order here? Tell us in the comments.
Which one are you trying first — [the drink or item] or [the drink or item]?
Which one would you prefer? [the drink or item], [the drink or item], or [the drink or item]?
Was your coffee delicious? We would love to hear from you in the comments.
